Introduction

HONEYST was a four-member boy band under FNC Entertainment. They were part of FNC's trainee system, NEOZ School, and competed on Mnet's survival show d.o.b (Dance or Band) as the NEOZ Band team. However, they lost to the dance team, which later debuted as SF9.

The group officially debuted on May 17, 2017, with their first single album Like You. On April 26, 2019, FNC Entertainment announced that HONEYST had officially disbanded.

Their name is a combination of the words "Honey" and "Artist".
